summary: End-to-end verification of iteration-8 features on StoreX. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass (addresses CRUD + default + XSS sanitization, notifications feed + mark-all-read, recently-viewed, admin analytics sales/revenue/customers/low-stock/CSV export, inventory list fix, robots.txt & sitemap.xml). Frontend: user & admin login OK, Addresses tab full CRUD via data-testids works and new address appears in list, Notifications panel loads, Recently Viewed rail shows on product detail page and profile dashboard after viewing multiple products, JSON-LD Product + BreadcrumbList schema injected in product page head, Admin Analytics page renders stat cards + sales-chart + range dropdown + Export Orders (CSV) button (data-testids all present), Admin Inventory now lists products (previously empty).

minor.issue: Error responses still include 'stack' trace field (dev-mode). Carryover from iter-7 — should be gated on NODE_ENV in production.

action_items: (Non-blocking, carried over) Gate error 'stack' in JSON responses on NODE_ENV=production in the global error handler.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend error handler still leaks Node stack traces in JSON responses (needs env-gated behavior).
RecentlyViewed component quietly falls back to localStorage on API error — this is fine, but any 401 during that call still surfaces in browser console; consider a silent catch.
seed_data_creation: During testing: created + deleted a TEST_John address and an XSS test address for user@storex.com; recorded product views for Puma Tshirt and Nike Air Max1 in the user's recently-viewed list. No orders placed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://d558cfe5-5754-479f-9b3d-d01f1b4b5a8f.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend Node on 8001 (routes under /api). All new endpoints use {status,'data':...} envelope and axios interceptor in client unwraps to response.data = inner data. Address schema fields (Zod) are: firstName,lastName,phone,addressLine1,addressLine2?,city,state,postalCode,country,label?,isDefault?. Admin analytics endpoints are /api/admin/analytics/{sales,revenue,customers}. Inventory list endpoint returns {inventory:[...]}. CSV export at /api/admin/orders/export. Only 2 products currently seeded (Puma Tshirt & Nike Air Max1). All 18 pytest tests are green.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no regressions found. Previously reported header LOGOUT-after-add-to-cart bug from iter-7 was not re-tested this round but is unrelated to iter-8 scope.
